mapper.sql: SELECT sm.match_id, sm.facility_id, sm.sport_id, sm.start_at, sm.end_at, sm.status, sm.photo_url FROM social_match sm JOIN facility f ON f.facility_id = sm.facility_id AND f.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN facility_manager fm ON fm.facility_id = f.facility_id AND fm.user_id = #{managerUserId} WHERE sm.match_id = #{matchId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO social_match (facility_id, sport_id, created_by, title, start_at, end_at, min_participants, max_participants, team_a_capacity, team_b_capacity, fee_per_person, required_skill, status, photo_url) VALUES (#{facilityId}, #{sportId}, #{createdBy}, #{title}, #{startAt}, #{endAt}, #{minParticipants}, #{maxParticipants}, #{teamACapacity}, #{teamBCapacity}, #{feePerPerson}, #{requiredSkill}, #{status}, #{photoUrl})
